verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Honeycomb exposing its own data as an MCP server so external AI agents can query Honeycomb (docs-9, docs-10, probe-3) — the reverse of the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Honeycomb so it can use their tools. No evidence shows Honeycomb acting as an MCP client or consuming third-party MCP tool servers.
